issues.description: The solution implementation defines getTotalNumberOfStudents with a boolean parameter (public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests)), whereas the problem statement and UML specify a no-argument method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int. This parameter mismatch deviates from the specified API and will confuse students and/or cause tests expecting a no-arg method to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make getTotalNumberOfStudents a no-argument method consistent with the UML and problem description: change the signature to public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() and implement it to return numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents. Update any internal calls (e.g., getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents and getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) to call the no-arg method.
